title: Remove the default email recipient while creating a question alert
steps: Open the saved question's 'Move, trash, and more...' menu.
Choose 'Create an alert' to open the New alert modal with its default email recipient.
Remove the sole default email recipient, then view the empty email-recipient field and the modal actions.

video_guide.summary: Watch Send now after the default recipient is removed. The recipient field becomes empty, but Send now remains enabled.

chapters.note: New alert contains Bobby Tables as the default recipient and an enabled Send now button.
Bobby Tables is removed; the empty recipient field appears while Send now retains its enabled appearance.
The recipient list is still empty and Send now remains enabled.
